name: Ultra Mobile
notes: Researched from the public ultramobile.com Help Center, plan page and the My Ultra sign-in page (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in). Ultra is prepaid on 30-day payment cycles with 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month plans. The sign-in page asks for Username or Phone Number plus password, with a Sign in via SMS option (identifier phone with that label). New accounts get a texted temporary password; one-time passcodes go by text or email for account changes (not modelled at sign-in; mfa none). Payments: Make a Payment online or in the app with a saved credit or debit card or the Ultra wallet; cash at Ultra retailers. Auto Renew charges the card at the renewal date with a reminder 2 days ahead; changes or turning it off must be done at least 24 hours before; 1-month plans get 10% off with Auto Renew. If not paid by the renewal date service is suspended; the number can be kept by paying within 60 days. Cancel = let the plan run out (cancel_service not_applicable); a $5/month Pause Plan keeps the number (GAP: pause cannot be modelled; mentioned in the cancel note). No paper bills, no payment plans, no future-dated payments documented (not_applicable, inferred). Plan prices are the published 1-month prices.

guest_pay.note: Pay in your online account or the Ultra Mobile App, or with cash at an Ultra retailer.

autopay.note: Auto Renew charges your card at the end of each plan cycle, with a reminder 2 days before. 1-Month Plans get 10% off with Auto Renew.

autopay_cancel.note: Turn Auto Renew off in your account or the app at least 24 hours before your renewal date.

scheduled_payment.note: Payments apply when you make them; Auto Renew pays automatically on your renewal date.

paperless.note: Ultra Mobile does not mail bills; balances and payments are in your account, the app, or by texting MENU to 6700.

payment_arrangement.note: Ultra Mobile does not offer payment plans; if you have not paid by your renewal date your service is suspended.

cancel_service.note: To cancel, let your service run out; you can return and keep your number by paying within 60 days. To keep your number during a break, switch to the $5-a-month Pause Plan under Manage Plan.

change_plan.note: With Auto Renew on, plan changes made at least 24 hours before renewal apply to your next renewal.

help.title: How can I renew my plan?
paragraphs: Renew in your online account or the Ultra Mobile App with Make a Payment, turn on Auto Renew there, or pay cash at an Ultra retailer.
The Ultra wallet can pay for add-ons or a renewal without re-entering card details; wallet funds are available right away and do not expire. 1-Month Plans get 10% off every month with Auto Renew.

help.title: How do I turn on Auto Renew?
paragraphs: Turn on Auto Renew at checkout, during activation, or later from the Auto Renew menu in your account or the app after adding a credit or debit card. Ultra reminds you 2 days before each charge.
Auto Renew starts at the end of your current plan cycle. Plan changes, card updates or turning it off must be done at least 24 hours before the scheduled renewal.

help.title: What if I want to cancel or pause my plan?
paragraphs: Switch to the Pause Plan for $5 a month under Manage Plan to keep your number and saved voicemails during a break.
To cancel, simply let your service run out. Without a payment after the renewal date the plan is suspended, and you can keep your number by paying within 60 days.

help.title: Ultra Mobile plans
paragraphs: 1-Month plans: 4GB $19, 8GB $24, 12GB $29, 24GB $39, Ultra Unlimited $49 and Ultra Unlimited+ $59, each with unlimited nationwide talk and text and international calling. 3-, 6- and 12-month versions are paid up front.
